{{Top|leg}}
A '''Ship Damage Waiver disk''' was issued by [[Harbormaster/Legends|harbormasters]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Algara II]] which absolved the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of any damage suffered by a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] while in port.
